emptyState.heading: MongoStudio
emptyState.body: Select a connection and collection on the left to get started.

prompts.firstCollectionName: Databases only exist once they hold a collection. Name for the first collection in "{{dbName}}":

confirm.deleteConnection: Delete connection "{{name}}"? This cannot be undone.
confirm.dropCollection: Drop collection "{{path}}"? This deletes all its documents and cannot be undone.
confirm.dropDatabase: Drop database "{{name}}"? This deletes all its collections and cannot be undone.

sidebar.noConnections: No connections yet. Click + to add one.

connection.name: Name
connection.sshHint: MongoDB host/port above is resolved on the remote side of the tunnel.

copyCollection.title: Copy Collection
copyCollection.description: Copy all documents from <bold>{{path}}</bold> to another connection.
copyCollection.noOtherConnections: No other open connections. Connect to another database first.
copyCollection.chooseTarget: Choose a target connection, database, and collection name.

copyDatabase.title: Copy Database
copyDatabase.description: Copy all collections and documents from <bold>{{dbName}}</bold> to another connection.
copyDatabase.noOtherConnections: No other open connections. Connect to another database first.
copyDatabase.chooseTarget: Choose a target connection and database name.

userEditor.passwordKeepHint: Leave both fields empty to keep the current password.
userEditor.rolesHint: Roles decide what the user may do. Pick the database each role applies to — a role on {{admin}} applies cluster-wide.
userEditor.noRoles: No roles assigned. This user cannot access any data.
userEditor.permissionsHint: Resolved by the server from the assigned roles, including inherited ones. Updates after saving.
userEditor.errorRoleIncomplete: Every role needs both a role name and a database.
userEditor.errorDuplicateRole: The same role is assigned twice.

bulkUpdate.title: Bulk Update
bulkUpdate.step1Hint: Specify the IDs of the target documents as an array in shell syntax (supports ObjectId(...), UUID(...), strings, numbers, ...).
bulkUpdate.step2Hint: {{count}} Target document(s). Specify update fields as an object in shell syntax—only these fields will be modified. A value of undefined removes the field. Alternatively, specify a raw update document with operators such as $set / $unset / $inc.
bulkUpdate.errorIdsMustBeArray: The target IDs must be specified as an array, for example, [ObjectId("...")].
bulkUpdate.errorUpdateMustBeObject: Updates must be specified as an object, e.g., { field: "value" }.
bulkUpdate.errorMixedFields: Fields and update operators must not be mixed (found: {{plainKeys}} next to {{opKeys}}). Use either pure field:value pairs or exclusively operators such as $set/$unset/$inc.
bulkUpdate.errorNoChanges: No changes specified. Enter a value or `undefined` (to remove) in at least one field.

general.heading: General
general.description: Here you can configure various general settings

editor.heading: Document Editor
editor.description: Here you can adjust various settings for the document editor

security.heading: Security
security.description: Here you can adjust your security settings
security.notSet: Master password is not set. Connections are stored unencrypted.
security.hintSetup: This password encrypts your saved connections on disk. It cannot be recovered if lost.
security.hintDisable: Connections will be stored unencrypted on disk after this.
security.successSetup: Master password enabled. Your connections are now encrypted on disk.
security.successDisable: Master password removed. Connections are now stored unencrypted.

backup.heading: Backup
backup.description: Export or import all settings and saved connections as a single JSON file.
